package probe

import "os/exec"

// -toolexec hands the go command's own environment to an arbitrary program it
// starts, so the exemption covers no such argument, in either form.
func toolchainToolexec() error {
	build := exec.Command("go", "build", "-toolexec", "sh -c env", "./cmd/x")
	return build.Run()
}

func toolchainToolexecEqual() error {
	list := exec.Command("go", "list", "--toolexec=sh -c env")
	_, err := list.Output()
	return err
}
